china-1919:p0053_2.rationale: Maximum number of snow days by month at Sicawei Observatory, Shanghai; these are climate observations.

china-1919:p0053_3.rationale: Prevailing monthly wind direction at Shanghai and Hongkong; these are climate observations.

china-1919:p0054_1.rationale: Monthly barometer, temperature, humidity and rainfall readings for Shanghai in 1910, with departures from average.

china-1919:p0055_1.rationale: Monthly barometer, temperature and rain/snow readings at Weihaiwei for 1910, with annual means and totals.

china-1919:p0056_1.rationale: Textual classification of races of the Chinese Empire by group, tribe and habitat; it contains no quantities. Population is the topic and ethnic classification the tag.

china-1919:p0057_1.rationale: Textual list of Turki-family races and their locations, with no quantities. It is an ethnic classification.

china-1919:p0057_2.rationale: Textual list of Tibetan-speaking Mongoloid races and their districts, with no quantities. It is an ethnic classification.

china-1919:p0057_3.rationale: Textual list of Chinese isolating-speech races (Punti, Hakka and others) and their locations. It is an ethnic classification with no quantities.

china-1919:p0057_4.rationale: Textual list of highland races of undetermined affinity (Miaotze group, Lolo and others) with their locations. It is an ethnic classification with no quantities. The source does not frame these groups as indigenous peoples.

china-1919:p0060_1.rationale: List of Manchu dynasty rulers with reign years; this is a textual roster in which the dates are only identifiers.
review_questions: Should there be a tag for dynastic rulers or reign lists? The imperial-household tag concerns the court and royal family, and historical-chronologies concerns event tables.
